review_scope: Synthetic text-only source consistency. This is not a clinical quality validation.

variants.uncapped: Control reproduces a repeated unfinished descriptionRemarks string (conflict-sample-42, finish=length). Normal greedy response duplicates the description in the conclusion.
variants.no-dictionary: Four natural stops, but false enlargement in normal data and missing-detail requests instead of identifying the supplied contradiction. Removing the vocabulary alone is not an accepted feature change.
variants.concise-ru: Four natural stops and preserved measurements. Both conflict responses omit source remarks. Requires expanded comparison before considering a replacement.
variants.concise-en: Four natural stops, but unsupported enlargement in normal data and omitted contradiction remarks. English instructions did not improve this screening.
variants.ru-examples: Examples avoid loops in four cases but both conflict responses have null remarks.
variants.ru-remarks-first: Reordering fields avoids loops in four cases but creates source-criticism errors and requests missing details instead of identifying the contradiction.
variants.ru-examples-first: One conflict output drops left-lobe measurements and selects the wrong source pair; another omits the conflict. Not accepted.
variants.ru-examples-no-dictionary: Four natural stops; normal conclusions are shorter, but conflict remarks remain null.
variants.structured-input: Four natural stops. Normal output invents enlargement, conflict remarks are null. This variant also removes patient metadata, so it is not an isolated test of serialization.
variants.audit-text: Standalone source audit copies source findings into the remarks field, including normal cases. Task decomposition did not establish a reliable audit.
variants.audit-ids: Returns an empty conflict list for all four cases, including explicit conflict inputs.
variants.full-task-last: Moving instructions after data did not fix source criticism: conflict-greedy enumerates much of the term vocabulary as missing lesion characteristics. Normal sampled conclusion claims enlargement.
variants.concise-task-last: Natural stops, but unsupported enlargement and follow-up recommendations on normal data; no conflict remarks.
variants.audit-task-last: Standalone audit still copies input fragments rather than explaining an inconsistency.
variants.alias-fields: Renaming fields to findings/impression/input_issues avoids loops in four cases but does not restore source conflict remarks; a normal conclusion introduces unsupported lymph-node blood flow. No API alias change is justified.
variants.expanded-baseline: 4 length stops, 4 repetitions, union 5 rejected. Invents adrenal measurements in kidney case and mixes term vocabulary into criticism. One bladder conflict remark quotes the conflicting claims.
variants.expanded-concise: All 16 stop, all remarks null, including 5 contradiction requests. Rejected for source-audit regression.
variants.actual-4b: All 16 stop; all remarks null; source contradictions omitted, ASR typo retained, stale negation retained after explicit correction. Candidate rejected.
variants.actual-15-4b: All 5 stop; both source conflicts omitted, ASR typo retained. Candidate not accepted.
variants.actual-27b: All 5 stop; both source conflicts omitted, ASR typo retained; one recommendations value is the literal string null. Candidate not accepted.
variants.final-smoke: Both stop and pass technical checks. Normal upper-bound volume changes to above normal in conclusion; conflict case asks for lesion size instead of the incompatible claims. No quality or robust repetition-fix claim.
